rationale: Price is sitting at 77% of today's range with the last 5 candles showing a micro-consolidation just below the 9-EMA ($239.19), suggesting neither a clean breakout nor a breakdown setup. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.75%, VIXY +11.40%) which creates downside risk, but AMZN has already absorbed a -4.61% gap and bounced ~4% off the session low, making a short entry at current levels late and a long entry into a deteriorating macro environment risky. With an existing working long in RGEN and near-zero daily loss budget remaining ($972.59 vs $973.53 limit), the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
